name: Niger
famous_for: Historic mud-brick Grand Mosque of Agadez (UNESCO gate to the Sahara), W National Park wildlife, and Wodaabe Gerewol dance.
tourists: Approx. 150,000 visitors; famous for Agadez clay minaret, Aïr Mountains rock art, and West African giraffe sanctuaries in Kouré.
must_know: The Gerewol festival is an ancient male beauty pageant where young Wodaabe men wear face paint and perform singing dances.
fun_fact: The Grand Mosque of Agadez is the tallest mud-brick structure in the world, standing 27 meters high since 1515.
